profile.dob.help: Issho is for adults. We check the date and keep only that you are 18 or over.

profile.gender.why: We ask so that nobody ends up the only woman or the only man in a group.
profile.womenOnly.label: Only women and non-binary people
profile.womenOnly.help: Go out only in groups of women and non-binary people. You can change this any time.
profile.languages.label: Which languages can you comfortably hold a conversation in for a whole outing?

profile.city.help: Yes means you are staying three months or more. Either answer is fine.

profile.conduct.rule2: Come with platonic intentions and respect boundaries.
profile.conduct.rule4: Turn up when you are going, and cancel early if you can't.
profile.conduct.rule5: Meet in the agreed public place and drink responsibly.
profile.conduct.rule6: Report anyone who makes you or others uncomfortable.
